verdict.rationale: Firebase documents programmatic API access to its data plane: Firestore offers a MongoDB-compatible API usable with existing drivers and tools, and Cloud Functions can be invoked via HTTPS requests and the Admin SDK. A community user also notes Firebase added an HTTP API. However, the pack has no first-party REST or management API reference for driving the product as a whole, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The CLI and MCP server belong to separate stories and are not credited here. missing for 10: documented public REST/management API reference, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, API coverage beyond Firestore data access, independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven workflows.
